7CITY COUNCIL
  REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
  MARCH 17, 2026 – 7:00 P.M.
  COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  5938 KAUFFMAN AVENUE - TEMPLE CITY, CALIFORNIA

PROCEDURE TO ADDRESS CITY COUNCIL: If you wish to address the City Council, please
complete a Speaker Request Form, indicating the agenda item number and submit it to the City
Clerk. There will be a maximum 30-minute period for comments on any subject with a 3-
minute time limit on each speaker, unless waived by Council. Written public comments
received by 5pm on the day of the meeting will be provided to the City Council and made part of
the meeting record. Please note that written public comments will not be read aloud by city staff
or City Council.
You have the opportunity to address the City Council at the following times:
  • AGENDA ITEM: at the time the Council considers the agenda item;

  • NON-AGENDA ITEM: at the time for PUBLIC COMMENTS. Please note that while
  the City Council values your comments, pursuant to the Brown Act, the Council cannot
  take action on any item not listed on the agenda; and

  • PUBLIC HEARING: at the time for public hearings under PUBLIC HEARING.

The listing of any item on the agenda includes the authority of the Council to take
action on such item and to approve, disapprove, or give direction on any item.

TO WATCH REGULAR MEETINGS LIVE OR RECORDED, VISIT:
  https://www.youtube.com/@ConnectWithTC

ACCESSIBILITY: In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special
assistance to participate in this meeting, please contact the City Clerk at (626) 285-2171.
Notification 72 hours prior to the meeting will enable the City to make reasonable
arrangements to ensure accessibility to this meeting.

  1. CALL TO ORDER – Mayor Sternquist

  2. ROLL CALL – Councilmember Chavez, Chen, Yu, Man, Sternquist

  3. INVOCATION

  4. PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

  5. CEREMONIAL MATTERS – PRESENTATION
 City Council Agenda
March 17, 2026
Page 2 of 5

  A. ADOPTION OF RESOLUTION NO. 26-5861 DECLARING THE RESULTS OF
  THE CANVASS OF VOTE FOR THE GENERAL MUNICIPAL ELECTION OF
  MARCH 3, 2026

  The City Council is requested to adopt a resolution reciting the facts of the General
  Municipal Election held on March 3, 2026. The City Clerk has certified the results
  of the canvass of vote for the election.

  Presentation:  City Clerk

  Recommendation:  Adopt Resolution No. 26-5861 reciting the facts of
  the election and declaring the results.

  B. OATH OF OFFICE TO ELECTED COUNCILMEMBERS

  The City Clerk will administer the Oath of Office and present the Certificate of
  Election to the Elected Councilmembers.

  C. REORGANIZATION OF THE CITY COUNCIL

  1. City Clerk calls for nominations for the seat of the Mayor.

  2. Mayor calls for nominations for the seat of Mayor Pro Tem.

6. CONSENT CALENDAR

  All Consent Calendar items may be approved in a single motion as recommended
  unless removed for further discussion. If members of the City Council or persons in the
  audience wish to discuss any matters listed on the Consent Calendar, please address
  them at this time.
  Recommendation:  Approve Items A through G per recommendations.

  A. APPROVAL OF MINUTES

  The City Council is requested to review and approve the Minutes of the Regular
  City Council Meeting of March 4, 2026.

  Recommendation:  Approve the  Minutes  of  the  City  Council
  Meetings.

  B. EXTENSION OF TEMPORARY CONDITIONAL OVERNIGHT PARKING PERMITS
  FOR PERSONS DISPLACED FROM FIRE IMPACTED AREAS
 City Council Agenda
March 17, 2026
Page 3 of 5

  The City Council is requested to extend the temporary conditional overnight parking
  permits for persons displaced from fire impacted areas.

  Recommendation:

  1. Approve a one-year extension of Temporary Conditional Overnight Parking
  Permits to displaced individuals within the fire-impacted areas seeking refuge in
  the city; and

  2. Waive fee for these Temporary Conditional Permits.

  C. ACCEPTANCE OF THE UPGRADING EXISTING TRAFFIC SIGNAL SYSTEM AT
  THE INTERSECTION OF BALDWIN AVE AND LIVE OAK PROJECT (CIP NO.
  P24-03)

  The City Council is requested to accept project completion for the Upgrading Existing
  Traffic Signal System at the Intersection of Baldwin Ave and Live Oak Project CIP No.
  P24-03.

  Recommendation:

  1. Accept project completion for the Upgrading Existing Traffic Signal System at the
  Intersection of Baldwin Ave and Live Oak Project CIP No. P24-03 (“Project”) as
  performed by Elecnor Belco Electric, Inc. for a total amount of $575,550.00;

  2. Authorize the City Manager to file a project Notice of Completion with the County
  of Los Angeles Registrar-Recorder; and

  3. Authorize the City Manager to release a retention payment of $28,777.55 to
  Elecnor Belco Electric, Inc. within 35 days following recordation of the Notice of
  Completion.

  D. ACCEPTANCE OF CITY HALL AND CITY COUNCIL CHAMBERS BUILDING
  ROOF AND HVAC REPLACEMENT PROJECT (CIP NO. P24-08)

  The City Council is requested to accept project completion for the City Hall and
  Council Chambers Building Roof and HVAC Replacement project, CIP NO. P24-08.

  Recommendation:

  1. Accept project completion for the City Hall and Council Chambers Building Roof
  and HVAC Replacement project (“Project”), CIP NO. P24-08 as performed by NKS
  Mechanical Contracting, Inc. (“Contractor”) for a total amount of $2,603,518.57;
 City Council Agenda
March 17, 2026
Page 4 of 5

  2. Authorize the City Manager to file a project Notice of Completion with the County
  of Los Angeles Registrar-Recorder; and

  3. Authorize the City Manager to release a retention payment of $130,175.93 to NKS
  Mechanical Contracting, Inc. within 35 days following recordation of the Notice of
  Completion.

  E. SECOND READING AND ADOPTION OF ORDINANCE NO. 25-1084, RELATING
  TO AND CONTAINING THE PROVISIONS/TEXT OF A TRANSACTIONS AND
  USE TAX MEASURE (MEASURE TC) THAT WAS APPROVED BY VOTERS AT
  THE MARCH 3, 2026, GENERAL MUNICIPAL ELECTION

  The City Council is requested to conduct the second reading by title only, waive
  further reading, and adopt Ordinance No. 25-1084.

  Recommendation:  The City Council is requested to conduct the
  second reading by title only, waive further
  reading, and adopt Ordinance No. 25-1084 to
  complete the approval of Measure TC pursuant to
  Revenue and Taxation Code Section 7285.9.
  F. VISA CARD REPORT

  The City Council is requested to review, receive, and file the Visa Card Report.

  Recommendation:  Receive and file the Visa Card Report.

  G. ADOPTION OF RESOLUTION NO. 26-5862 APPROVING PAYMENT OF BILLS
  FOR FISCAL YEAR 2025-26

  The City Council is requested to adopt Resolution No. 26-5862 authorizing the
  payment of bills for fiscal year 2025-26.

  Recommendation:  Adopt Resolution No. 26-5862 authorizing the
  payment of bills for fiscal year 2025-26.

7. PUBLIC COMMENTS ON ITEMS NOT LISTED ON THE AGENDA

  The City Council will now hear public comments regarding items not listed on the
  agenda. The procedure to address the City Council is highlighted on the first page of
  this agenda.
 City Council Agenda
March 17, 2026
Page 5 of 5

8. RECOGNITION AND PRESENTATIONS

  The City Council meeting will relocate to the Temple City Woman's Club located at
  9704 Woodruff Avenue, Temple City, for City Council recognition and ceremonial
  presentations. The meeting will take a brief recess to allow the City Council, staff, and
  members of the public to walk to the Woman's Club.

9. ADJOURNMENT
NOTICE: Staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business of
this Agenda are available for viewing on the City’s website at www.templecity.us and are
on file in the Office of the City Clerk located at City Hall, 9701 Las Tunas Drive, Temple
City, California, and available for review during regular office hours. Written documentation
submitted to the City Council after distribution of the agenda packet can be obtained at the
City Clerk’s Office during regular office hours.

AGENDA NOTIFICATION SUBSCRIPTION:
If you wish to receive an agenda email notification, please email your request to
cityclerk@templecity.us or call (626) 285-2171.

FUTURE CITY MEETINGS
